results.title: Lighting up the hidden highways of plants: IITGN scientists redefine xylem imaging
results.description: IIT Gandhinagar and Regional Centre for Biotechnology develop next-generation fluorescent probes for ultra-precise visualisation of plant water-conducting tissues Repurposed biomedical imaging molecules deliver sharper, faster and highly selective xylem staining with significantly lower dye concentration Breakthrough promises to accelerate research in plant vascular biology, climate resilience, drought tolerance and sustainable agriculture Novel probes outperform conventional [...]
